row.reason: Both are building-products manufacturers selling through distributors and home centers to contractors and builders. Owens Corning sells roofing, insulation and doors (plus glass-fiber composites and nonwovens). Simpson sells structural connectors, anchors and fasteners. The customer channels overlap but the products do not compete, so this is adjacent rather than direct.

T:P1.2.text: Owens Corning is a branded building products leader with three complementary market-leading businesses providing roofing, insulation, and doors

T:P1.3.text: Owens Corning is building a sustainable future through material innovation.

T:P2.3.text: Our global nonwovens business is dedicated to transforming four key markets - construction, flooring, interiors, and industrial - with differentiated solutions that enable a world of possibilities for architects, builders, and designers.

T:P2.5.text: Compared to traditional ceiling materials, GLAS- POWERED™ ceiling facers & backers enable higher performance standards. Whether you're building for a brighter, quieter office space or a mold conscious healthcare facility, each veil request is tailor-made to fit your needs.

C:S1.1.text: Simpson Strong-Tie is the operating subsidiary of Simpson Manufacturing and makes structural connectors, anchors, and fasteners for wood, concrete, and masonry construction. Its range is broad: reinforcement products include anchors, angles, bases, caps, connectors, fasteners, and hangers, and it also offers prefabricated shearwalls, powder-actuated tools, and adhesives.

C:S2.1.text: On customers, one source says The Home Depot is its largest customer. Another describes its market as commercial and residential construction, furniture, and do-it-yourself (DIY) markets.

C:S3.1.text: A retailer-focused profile lists Ace Hardware, True Value, Do it Best, Orgill as home improvement distributors, and says independent home improvement retailers often know the regional building requirements and ensure their customers choose the Simpson Strong-Tie products that best suit their needs.

C:S4.1.text: Products are distributed nationally through an extensive network of distributors and dealers. The Simpson Strong-Tie sales team operates nationally and is equipped with technical support and training to assist with specification and jobsite support to service the needs of our customers.

C:S5.1.text: Online resellers such as CONFAST have also been named an official eCommerce distributor of Simpson Strong-Tie products.
